question: H1 2025: which amount belongs to battery, tariffs and realignment?
evidence: S010 p.5 & p.30 (verbatim): battery special expenses EUR 0.4bn; US tariffs additional expenses EUR 0.4bn. S016 p.6 fn1: H1 2025 included EUR 0.7bn realignment and EUR 0.4bn tariffs. S009 p.28: chart sub-split shows 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.2 (labels not assignable from text).
finding: Tariffs = EUR 0.4bn (FACT, two sources agree). Realignment incl. battery combined = EUR 0.7bn (FACT, S016). Battery alone = EUR 0.4bn per S010 text, which leaves realignment ex-battery ~EUR 0.3bn (DERIVED); the slide's 0.5/0.2 pair contradicts this at EUR 0.1bn rounding level.
consequence: Use the combined realignment+battery line (0.7bn) as the adjustment. The internal split does not change adjusted EBIT, so the conflict is immaterial to the core question. Log the slide/text conflict; visually check S009 slide 28 once.

question: Does the D&A / depreciation disclosure include impairment losses?
evidence: S017 p.12 and S010 p.11: automotive EBITDA adds back D&A 'and changes in value' of PP&E, capitalised development costs and other intangibles. S010 p.32: PP&E depreciation includes Cellforce impairment of EUR 295m. S011 slide 34 footnote: 2025 D&A includes ~EUR 1,200m impairment losses from the strategic realignment. S017 p.30: H1 2026 impairments eBike EUR 43m, Cellforce EUR 18m.
finding: YES. Depreciation on capex (A11) and total D&A (A12) include impairments. The same impairments also sit inside the management-labelled one-offs (X01/X02).
consequence: Double-count risk confirmed. Before using D&A movements as a 'non-cash tailwind', subtract disclosed impairments (new variable X05). Preliminary illustration (DERIVED, not yet entered): H1 2025 depreciation on capex 1,156 less 295 Cellforce impairment = ~861, vs H1 2026 854 - the apparent EUR 302m depreciation drop largely disappears once cleaned. H2 2025 (FY less H1) will carry ~EUR 0.9bn of impairments and must be cleaned too. Amortisation (A09) may also include impairments of capitalised development costs - split to be located in S012 notes.

question: Is the R&D/D&A table available consistently for H1 2023, H1 2024 and FY?
evidence: S001 (H1 2023 deck): total R&D only, no table. S002 p.29 Note 3: capitalised dev. costs, capitalisation ratio, amortisation for H1 2023. S005 p.28 and S009 p.43: R&D rows only, no depreciation-on-capex row. S003 p.66 and S007 p.78: R&D rows only. S011 slide 34: FULL table (R&D, capex, depreciation on capex, total D&A) for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025. S016 slide 25: FULL table for H1 2024, H1 2025, H1 2026.
finding: Full table available for 6 of 7 periods via two documents (S011 for FY, S016 for H1 2024-2026). H1 2023: R&D rows available (S002), depreciation on capex NOT disclosed.
consequence: H1 2023 depreciation on capex = DERIVED as (auto EBITDA - auto EBIT) - amortisation. H2 values for 2024 and 2025 = FY less H1 (DERIVED). H2 2023 depreciation on capex will also be DERIVED because H1 2023 is. Use latest-document comparatives.

question: Consistency of prior-year one-off figure
evidence: S018 (H1 2026 press release): prior-year net realignment costs 'around 800 million'. S016 p.6: EUR 0.7bn realignment in H1 2025.
finding: Unreconciled EUR 0.1bn difference between two Porsche documents of the same date (rounding or different scope).
consequence: Use S016 (analyst deck, itemised) as primary; show +/- EUR 0.1bn sensitivity on the H1 2025 adjusted EBIT.

question: Definition change in value-per-car metric
evidence: S001 p.9: EUR 113k per delivery (H1 2023). S005 p.20: H1 2023 ASP per vehicle sold = EUR 111k. S009 p.29 shows per-delivery and p.32 per-vehicle-sold side by side.
finding: Porsche has shown two different per-car metrics. Only 'per vehicle sold' (O06) is available consistently H1 2023-H1 2026.
consequence: O06 is the only per-car time series. O09 kept for reference, not analysed.

question: Header defect in S025 fact sheet
evidence: S025 sheet '01 - Group EBIT', YTD block: cell F28 labelled 'Q1 2025'; values F29:F35 equal the discrete Q1 2026 column (F12:F18), not Q1 2025 (R12:R18).
finding: Porsche file carries a mislabelled header. Values are Q1 2026.
consequence: Extraction script relabels it and flags rows HEADER_FIX. Never read periods from YTD headers without the quarter-sum check (QC3).

question: Is the extraordinary-items bracket additive in the bridge?
finding: The one-off bracket is an 'of which' already contained in the four buckets.
consequence: B05 redefined as memo. Bridge check = prior EBIT + B01..B04 = current EBIT.

question: Restatement of H1 2025 R&D costs
evidence: S010 p.9 (July 2025): total automotive R&D costs H1 2025 = 1,258; R&D recognised in income statement = 1,284. S016 slide 25 and S017 p.9 (July 2026): 1,264 and 1,290.
finding: Porsche restated H1 2025 R&D costs by +EUR 6m in the following year.
consequence: Latest-document rule: 1,264 used. Logged so the auditor can see the choice.

question: Do Porsche's EBIT-bridge buckets reconcile to the reported P&L?
evidence: Bridge buckets from S003/S005/S007/S009/S011/S016 compared with changes in the S025 fact-sheet P&L (Checks CHK8-CHK10 in PCL_02).
finding: Yes, for all six periods: 'SG&A' = change in distribution + administrative expenses; 'Other' = change in net other operating result; 'Gross margin w/o R&D' + 'R&D' = change in gross profit. So the R&D bucket sits inside cost of sales.
consequence: Bucket definitions are now evidence-based, not assumed. FY2025 slide-text mapping (-4.17/-1.11/+0.26/-0.21) confirmed by this reconciliation.

question: Consistency of D&A across documents
evidence: EBITDA tables (S002 p.9, S006 p.10, S010 p.11, S017 p.12, S013, S026) vs R&D/D&A tables (S011 slide 34, S016 slide 25).
finding: Automotive EBITDA = automotive EBIT + D&A holds exactly in every period; the D&A in both table types is the same number (e.g. H1 2024 1,364; FY2025 4,192).
consequence: Confirms A12 includes impairments in every period (the EBITDA definition adds back impairments).

question: Machine-readable fact sheets
evidence: Porsche publishes an XLSX fact sheet per quarter (S019-S025).
finding: S024 and S025 inspected. They cover quarterly group P&L, automotive cash flow, net liquidity, vehicle sales and deliveries (region, model incl. Macan ICE/BEV) from Q1 2022. They do NOT contain segment revenue/EBIT, EBITDA, D&A, R&D, capex, one-offs, ASP or BEV share.
consequence: Fact-sheet variables are extracted by script (pcl_extract_factsheets.py -> fact_sheet_long.csv). Only PDF-only variables are entered by hand (PCL_02_Manual_Inputs.xlsx).
